# TinySoundFont

`tsf.h` is vendored unchanged from
https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont/tree/853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa
(MIT, version 0.9). `LICENSE.TinySoundFont` preserves its license.

Only source code is included. No sample SoundFonts, music, or proprietary assets
from upstream or SongHub are shipped. The JNI wrapper is KaraokeFlow code.
